segments.text: Firewood Splitting Simulator is a browser physics toy where you swing an axe and split logs. That's it. No install, no account. Just open the page
and start chopping. The satisfaction is entirely in the crack of the split and the two halves tumbling apart. Zero stakes, weirdly addictive, perfect for a
30-se secondond mental break. Sometimes the best software does exactly one useless thing extremely
